name: claudally
description: Connects Claude Desktop to Tally Prime through the Claudally server installed on this PC.
long_description: Read and enter Tally Prime data from Claude Desktop. This extension is a small launcher: it starts the Claudally server already installed on this PC by Claudally-Setup.exe, so install Claudally first. Your Tally settings stay in that install; nothing is copied into the extension.

install_dir.title: Claudally install folder
install_dir.description: Only needed if Claudally was installed somewhere other than Program Files. Leave empty to find it automatically.
